concerns.text: Unit‑test T014a is marked completed while its producer task T014 (implementation of normalization script) is still pending, violating producer‑before‑consumer ordering.
Unit‑test T016a‑test is completed before the implementation task T016a (Pearson correlation generation) is done, breaking the required task order.
Unit‑test T016b‑test is completed prior to its producer task T016b (edge extraction) which remains pending.
Unit‑test T017a is marked completed while the core mapping implementation task T017 is still pending.
Edge‑list exporter task T018 is completed but depends on identifier mapping (T017), which is not yet implemented, causing a consumer‑before‑producer violation.

Integration test T020 is marked completed even though several upstream US‑1 tasks (normalization, correlation, mapping, edge extraction) are still pending, making the integration test non‑executable and violating independent shippability of the US‑1 block.
